thread:
ivy (Billing): Heads up — nightly invoice_job_2026-04-01 created ~10 PDFs where the compute line is missing but totals include compute. Example: invoice 20260401-ALTA-09 shows total 3,200.00, compute 2,400.00 in summary but no 'Compute - dedicated' line.

omar (Billing Eng): I see renderer warnings during the job: failed to resolve sku for tenant 412, occasionally sku_lookup returns empty dict instead of null. quick log: WARN renderer: sku_lookup returned {} for sku_ref=zzz-123.

kevin (SRE): DB telemetry shows 502s against catalog-service cluster at 01:06:12Z for ~18s. That overlaps billing window.

omar (Billing Eng): renderer code treats falsy but non-null differently and skips line. Need to normalize sku_lookup to return null on error and add a fallback line when compute_total>0.

nina (Accounting): GL import already flagged 5 invoices. We need a CSV with invoice_id, customer_id, compute_total, missing_compute_flag, original_pdf_url for reconciliation.

ivy (Billing): Also found 2 customers who received duplicate invoice PDFs with same invoice_id but different line breakdowns. Likely retry created second artifact.

omar (Billing Eng): action plan: 1) patch renderer to normalize sku lookup and add fallback compute line if compute_total>0; 2) make PDF artifact write conditional (put-if-absent) to avoid duplicate artifacts; 3) run dedupe job and re-render affected invoices; 4) produce reconciliation CSV and customer notification draft.

kevin (SRE): I'll pause auto-retries for the renderer for next billing window and schedule dedupe window 2026-04-01 03:00-03:30 UTC. Also will check catalog-service deploys.

ivy (Billing): please attach CSV to this thread when ready. omar, ping when hotfix deployed. ops-bot: automated alert invoice_job_2026-04-01: 10 missing-line renders, 2 duplicate artifacts detected.
